name: Gero (Japan, city)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Gero city emblem in green, light blue and yellow: green and light blue curved strokes with a yellow oval.
history: Municipal flag of Gero, a city in Gifu Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 21 June 2004.
